why: Publishes `findDependencyCycles`' output unrotated. That function walks `graph.keys()`, which is the order the issues arrived in, so the same two-issue cycle comes back as [1, 2] or [2, 1] purely by which page GitHub returned first. The audit only formats the members, so it never had to care; a committed snapshot would flip between the two forms and put a spurious diff in every export. Rotating to the lowest member is what makes the file's determinism promise hold for this field.
killedBy: buildSnapshot reports a blocked-by cycle the same way whichever issue GitHub returned first
normaliseCycles rotates every cycle to its lowest member and orders the list
